summary: Ozone's mid-aspect 3-strut all-rounder derived from the Vortex, replacing the Enduro line. Dacron frame and 16-point bridle; pitched at beginners through advanced riders for big air, loops, wave and foil at a lower price than the Vortex.
best_for: Freeriders who want a forgiving all-rounder with real big air and looping ability

reviews.video_title: Big Air Kite Review 29 - Ozone Reflex
reviews.excerpt: the Reflex is effectively Ozone's purely Dacron version of the Vortex. Both are three strut freeride kites that do a bit of everything.
reviews.verdict: Kites like this are some of the few on the market that I think you can recommend for riders taking their first lessons and going all the way up to more advanced big air progression and general free riding.
reviews.summary: Jason sees the Reflex as the Dacron Vortex: medium-to-heavy steering, manageable speed and strong power for a 3-strut. It boosts near 5-strut kites like the Orbit and Era 2 and is easier to time, but jumped 10–15% lower than the Vortex V2. Loops are predictable, though you need to pilot them through to the catch.

structured_review.summary: A forgiving, plug-and-play 3-strut Dacron all-rounder that boosts close to popular 5-strut big air kites while staying easy to time and control. It gives up about 10–15% of jump height and plenty of responsiveness to its Aluula sibling, the Vortex, and its heavier, slightly slower loop needs active piloting.
pros: Very manageable speed makes it easy to hit the sweet spot when sending
Boosting close to 5-strut big air kites like the North Orbit and Flysurfer Era 2
Stable when parked overhead, which helps board-offs and rotations
Suits riders from first lessons through advanced big air progression
cons: Noticeably less height, lift and responsiveness than the Aluula Vortex
Loops are slower and sit deeper in the window; the catch needs active piloting
Not the best choice for a first kiteloop in sizes 9m and up
structured_review.best_for: Progressing riders who want one affordable kite for freeride, big air and early looping.
structured_review.not_for: Riders after maximum hangtime or a quick, pivoting first-loop kite.
structured_review.rec_blurb: The Vortex's easier Dacron sibling: steady, powerful and simple to time.
